shown.message:
I fixed one legibility problem in the built paper: in Fig 7, the legend of panels A and B sat on top of the data points. I found it by reading the PDF the system built from `paper-repo` `dev` 6cc8aaa. I moved the legend above the panels and pushed the figure and its generator to `paper-repo` `dev` (5baf4ba) and `figtab-repo` `main`.

- **Cost:** Fig 7 is now 28 pt (0.39 in) taller, 391 × 316 pt. The content is unchanged. The report role owns the nine-page fit, so I told it on `figtab-repo`#3. I offered to shorten panel C if the pages no longer hold.
- **Other main figures:** in that build I saw no overlaps. I read Figs 1, 3, 5 and 9 as rendered at 80 dpi, so this is a visual check, not a type-size measurement.
- **Not drawn yet:** the absolute R² of log RMSE (Fig 7, Table 2), the `or_fit` rows in Fig 5, the finer p grid for Fig 3 and the P6 panel for Fig 9 are not drawn because analysis has not delivered them. `experiment-repo`#9 is still open with no reply.

`figtab-repo`#2 stays open until those redraws are done.
